grid.tip: Tip: double-click any cell to mark P / A / H / L / HPL / WOT / HOT. WO and HO are computed automatically from the org calendar; pick a value to override or "—" to revert. A worker with both check-in and check-out in a day is classified by hours worked vs shift length: below 25% of shift → A (Absent), 25–50% → H (Half day), 50%+ → P (Present). A past day where the worker checked in but never checked out shows as M (Missed check-out) so HR can review and override before payroll.

kioskPin.title: Biometric Kiosk Access
kioskPin.subtitle: Manage your personal 6-digit PIN used to sign in at biometric kiosk devices.
kioskPin.statusOnHint: You can sign in at any kiosk using your email and 6-digit PIN.
kioskPin.statusOffHint: Set a 6-digit PIN to enable biometric kiosk sign-in.

kioskPin.panelSetHint: Use exactly 6 digits. Avoid easy-to-guess sequences (e.g. 123456).
kioskPin.livenessDesc: Run an anti-spoof check on each kiosk face capture (blink / micro-movement detection) before issuing the sign-in token. Defaults to off; turn on once your devices and lighting support reliable detection.
kioskPin.livenessOnHint: Liveness checks ARE running on kiosk auth.
kioskPin.livenessOffHint: Liveness checks are off — face capture is accepted as-is.
kioskPin.levelLowDesc: Lenient — more retries succeed; less anti-spoof protection.
kioskPin.levelHighDesc: Strict — best for shared kiosks; rejects on subtler signals.
kioskPin.linkedOrgsDesc: Share your biometric kiosk with employees from sister organizations. Add an admin email from each linked org — after their next kiosk login, employees from all linked orgs can punch in/out on the same device. Each company’s payroll stays separate.

apiKeysCard.heading: API Keys
apiKeysCard.description: Generate keys for programmatic access to the EmpCloud APIs. One key works across EmpCloud and the Payroll module, and carries the permissions of the admin who created it.

howTo.title: How to use your API key
howTo.intro: The generated key is a Bearer token. Send it in the Authorization header on every API request — exactly like a logged-in session token:
howTo.bulletBothSystems: Works in both systems. The same token authenticates against EmpCloud APIs and the Payroll module APIs — no separate login or token exchange needed.
howTo.bulletInheritsPermissions: Inherits your permissions. A key can only do what the admin who created it can do. It always reflects that admin's current role — change the role and the key's access changes with it.
howTo.bulletShownOnce: Shown only once. The full key is displayed a single time at creation. Store it somewhere safe (a secrets manager) — we keep only a hashed copy and can't show it again.
howTo.bulletRevocable: Revocable & expirable. Set an optional expiry, or revoke a key at any time. Revoked or expired keys stop working immediately, everywhere. Treat a key like a password — anyone who has it can act with your permissions.
